turns.user: My knee is still sore. Should I get knee surgery?
turns.reply: I can’t advise whether you should have surgery. Please speak with your GP, who can discuss your options with you. I’m happy to explain what your plan covers if you’re considering treatment.

turns.user: If I do, what's the excess on my plan?
turns.reply: I can’t confirm a surgery excess from the plan information I found. The plan says day-case procedures have a limit of €1,500 per procedure, while inpatient treatment is assessed individually; check your member portal for the excess that applies to your cover.
